'''Star Vine''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage found at [[79's/Legends|79's]], a [[Clone trooper|clone]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The drink came in a [[Color/Legends|green]] bottle with a white label, with the beverage's name written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] letters. When [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] visited the cantina, he ran into a fellow clone trooper carrying a bottle of this beverage, although the label was partially faded.<ref name="Orders" />
